mapper.select: select id, topic_id, commercial_context_type, commercial_context_id, close_kind, initiator_member_id, original_sales_basis, original_contribution_count, platform_rate, guarantee_base_rate, guarantee_step_rate, guarantee_max_merchant, original_verified_merchant_count, origin_calculation_version, contract_snapshot, source_fingerprint, closed_at, created_at from coop_settlement_cash_close where topic_id=#{topicId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into coop_settlement_cash_contribution (cash_close_id, registration_id, payer_registration_id, parent_order_no, registration_no, payer_order_no, owner_type, owner_id, source_topic_id, snapshot_payment_status, snapshot_registration_status, snapshot_verification_status, snapshot_payable_amount, sales_basis_amount, registration_snapshot, source_fingerprint) select #{cashCloseId}, #{registrationId}, #{payerRegistrationId}, #{parentOrderNo}, #{registrationNo}, #{payerOrderNo}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{sourceTopicId}, #{snapshotPaymentStatus}, #{snapshotRegistrationStatus}, #{snapshotVerificationStatus}, #{snapshotPayableAmount}, #{salesBasisAmount}, #{registrationSnapshot}, #{sourceFingerprint} from cms_registration r join cms_registration payer on payer.id=#{payerRegistrationId} where r.id=#{registrationId} and r.owner_type=#{ownerType} and r.owner_id=#{ownerId} and binary r.registration_no=binary #{registrationNo} and payer.owner_type=r.owner_type and payer.owner_id=r.owner_id and payer.member_id=r.member_id and binary payer.registration_no=binary #{payerOrderNo} and (binary r.parent_order_no <=> binary #{parentOrderNo}) and (binary payer.parent_order_no <=> binary r.parent_order_no) and ((r.parent_order_no is null and payer.id=r.id) or (r.parent_order_no is not null and r.parent_order_no regexp '[^[:space:]]' and payer.payable_amount is not null and payer.payable_amount>0 and not exists ( select 1 from cms_registration sibling where binary sibling.parent_order_no=binary r.parent_order_no and (not (sibling.owner_type <=> r.owner_type) or not (sibling.owner_id <=> r.owner_id) or not (sibling.member_id <=> r.member_id) or sibling.payable_amount is null or sibling.payable_amount<0 or (sibling.id<>payer.id and sibling.payable_amount<>0))))) and (r.payment_status <=> #{snapshotPaymentStatus}) and (r.registration_status <=> #{snapshotRegistrationStatus}) and (r.verification_status <=> #{snapshotVerificationStatus}) and (r.payable_amount <=> #{snapshotPayableAmount}) and #{salesBasisAmount}=case when r.payment_status=2 and r.registration_status=2 then r.payable_amount else 0 end
mapper.select: select id, cash_close_id, registration_id, payer_registration_id, parent_order_no, registration_no, payer_order_no, owner_type, owner_id, source_topic_id, snapshot_payment_status, snapshot_registration_status, snapshot_verification_status, snapshot_payable_amount, sales_basis_amount, registration_snapshot, source_fingerprint, created_at from coop_settlement_cash_contribution where registration_id=#{registrationId} for update

select id, cash_close_id, event_type, source_id, source_registration_id, source_amount, source_snapshot, source_fingerprint, created_at from coop_settlement_cash_event where cash_close_id=#{cashCloseId} and event_type=#{eventType} and source_id=#{sourceId} for update
